run_MessageTest: run the MessageTest unittest class to verify protobuf message parsing and serialization against golden data
run_Proto2Test: run the Proto2Test unittest class to test proto2 field presence, extensions, and enum validation
run_Proto3Test: run the Proto3Test unittest class to test proto3 field presence, map fields, and unknown enum handling
run_PackedFieldTest: run the PackedFieldTest unittest class to verify packed and unpacked repeated field serialization
run_OversizeProtosTest: run the OversizeProtosTest unittest class to test parsing behavior for protos exceeding the default size limit
